aptu-coder

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) code-intelligence server that gives AI coding agents pre-parsed symbol tables instead of raw file bytes, cutting token usage by up to 59% in the cited benchmark conditions (see Benchmarks). OpenSSF silver certified: fewer than 1% of open source projects reach this level.

> [!NOTE] > Native agent tools (regex search, path matching, file reading) handle targeted lookups well. `aptu-coder` handles the mechanical, non-AI work: mapping directory structure and extracting symbols, so a coding agent's context window is spent reasoning instead of re-deriving structure on every call. Most code-intelligence tooling for AI agents indexes a codebase into a cloud embedding or vector store and retrieves by similarity search. aptu-coder instead parses the codebase on-device with tree-sitter and serves it locally over MCP: no source code leaves the machine, and retrieval is exact (symbol tables) rather than approximate (nearest-neighbor similarity). ## Benchmarks Paired comprehension tasks on Claude Code (MCP mode vs native shell search). Methodology: [Django](https://github.com/django/django) auth migration ([v12](https://github.com/clouatre-labs/aptu-coder/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/v12/methodology.md)) and [OpenFAST](https://github.com/OpenFAST/openfast) AeroDyn integration audit ([v13](https://github.com/clouatre-labs/aptu-coder/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/v13/methodology.md)). | Task | Mode | Sonnet 4.6 | Haiku 4.5 | Savings | |---|---|---|---|---| | Django (Python) | MCP | 112k tokens, $0.39 | 406k tokens, $0.42 | **59% fewer tokens, 59% cheaper** (Sonnet) | | Django (Python) | Native | 276k tokens, $0.95 | 473k tokens, $0.53 | 14% fewer tokens, 21% cheaper (Haiku) | | OpenFAST (Fortran) | MCP | 472k tokens, $1.65 | 687k tokens, $0.72 | **46% fewer tokens, 42% cheaper** (Sonnet) | | OpenFAST (Fortran) | Native | 877k tokens, $2.85 | 2162k tokens, $2.21 | **68% fewer tokens, 68% cheaper** (Haiku) | A real end-to-end multi-agent run against this repository itself: five refactoring issues (#1578–#1582) fixed by the [coder skill](https://github.com/clouatre-labs/agentic-coder-skill) in one orchestrated session — 23 subagent spawns (5 scout, 1 guard, 10 build, 7 check), ~1h42m, three human interventions — producing PRs #1584–#1588, all merged with CI green. ### base_clause and class_interface_clause rules

Source: https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/common/define-grammar.js

The rules that carry out the role of the queried parent_class/base_classes/interfaces: base_clause matches 'extends' followed by names, and class_interface_clause matches 'implements' followed by names. Neither field name exists as a class_declaration field.

```javascript
      base_clause: $ => seq(
        keyword('extends'),
        commaSep1($._name),
      ),

// ...

      class_interface_clause: $ => seq(
        keyword('implements'),
        commaSep1($._name),
      ),
```

--------------------------------

### class_declaration rule definition

Source: https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/common/define-grammar.js

The grammar rule for class_declaration: it defines the field 'name' (plus 'attributes' and 'body'), and uses optional base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) nodes instead of parent_class/base_classes/interfaces fields. Method declarations appear inside the body's declaration_list, and functions are named function_definition in this grammar.

```javascript
      class_declaration: $ => prec.right(seq(
        optional(field('attributes', $.attribute_list)),
        repeat($._modifier),
        keyword('class'),
        field('name', reserved('classes', $.name)),
        optional($.base_clause),
        optional($.class_interface_clause),
        field('body', $.declaration_list),
      )),
```

--------------------------------

Source: https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/php/src/node-types.json
